name: Iowa State University
notes: Scope: the three automatic Iowa-resident recognition awards only. Utah-specific URL could not be read; no nonresident amounts assumed. National Merit recognition excluded. Official NPC uses historical data; COA unknown.
review_issues: General reuse terms not located on inspected admissions page; owner review needed.
Nonresident state-specific tables are outside this draft's coverage.

research.policy_note: Bounded manual public-page review. Robots does not disallow this scholarship path. Only public facts and paraphrases retained; no logos, screenshots or copied page prose. General terms, where not located, remain an owner review item.

tiers.gpa_basis_note: Cumulative high-school GPA on school's 4-point scale, rounded to hundredths; weighted GPA accepted under published school-wide transcript conditions.
tiers.renewal_conditions: Continuous full-time enrollment, at least 12 credits per semester, resident tuition and minimum 2.50 cumulative GPA; fall/spring only, for four years.
tiers.requires_action: Iowa-resident admission; priority date March 1, 2027. Final transcripts and official tests must substantiate eligibility. First-year enrollment restrictions apply; awards cannot stack with full-tuition admissions awards.

eligibility_rules.note: Confirm official GPA/transcript requirements and citizenship/permanent-resident/refugee/asylee eligibility. Prior college coursework and first-year enrollment restrictions apply.
